name: Decisive safety-filter test (three-block)

test_A_fixed_states.what: the 75 filter-panel states (32 forks, 40 safe, 3 not at rest excluded) with corrected ground truth (results/program_b/t1_filter, truth_v3)
arms: CEM filter with the clean plain world model (eval/cem_filter.py)
test_A_fixed_states.measure: topple probability of the executed chunk = share of 64 MuJoCo futures (corrected perception error + execution noise, truth_A seeds) in which a neighbour topples; abstentions counted as 0 and reported separately
test_A_fixed_states.decision: the filter WORKS on fork states if its mean topple probability is lower than no filter with a paired Wilcoxon signed-rank p < 0.05, and it changes no more than 10% of safe-state actions

test_B_closed_loop.what: user's diffusion policy, closed loop, stress layouts: neighbours at 0.3x mass (calibration 6/20 topples), execution noise on, settled start, 48 s
test_B_closed_loop.pairing: each episode i uses the same layout, policy seed 4000+i and noise sequence in every arm; arms diverge only where the filter acts
arms: policy alone (monitor logs alarms, never acts)
test_B_closed_loop.decision: the filter WORKS in closed loop if neighbour topples drop with McNemar exact p < 0.05 on the 100 paired episodes AND task success (lift >= 3 cm, no topple) is not lower by more than 10 points
test_B_closed_loop.caveat: 0.3x neighbour mass is invisible to the camera and outside the world model's training physics, so this tests the filter under unmodelled physics

per_decision_truth: every decision state saved; 64-future ground truth computed afterwards (eval/loop_truth.py) to grade monitor alarms against forks

arm_cem_v2.added: 2026-10-14, before running v2 and before tests A/B of v1 finished (interim v1: fork topple 27% -> 25%, 6 of 22 fork states made worse)
arm_cem_v2.change: intent becomes a hard constraint: a candidate is acceptable only if the monitor sees no split AND its predicted majority outcome lies within 1.0 model-error floor of the nominal chunk's predicted majority outcome; among acceptable candidates the smallest action change wins; none acceptable -> hold (abstain)
arm_cem_v2.reason: v1 could move an action into a region where all futures topple (no split, wrongly treated as safe)
arm_cem_v2.tests: same test A (fixed states) and test B (paired closed loop, same episodes, seeds and baseline arm) with the same decision rules
